text: ok this is good a few things id like you to get at next are: we want to be able to re-locate our uv mapping of the model so we can allow for better texture mapped images and ability to edit outside of the editor. for this we need to make sure that we can see every outliners rect and be able to reshape it into something more uniform than the spagetti that the uv shits out right now. next when it comes to this shader menu in the color picker it is complete trash and i want you to take on something better the shape like the content browser handles this, so i can pick from a selection of 3-4x more on display than this brings, then last to add there for you is that i would like to have a way to draw paths, but both for painting and for planes. basically, i want to be able to draw a path with a pen tool all the same as paths behave in other known editors, and when i close it and confirm it i want to be able to have that turn into a plane and take however many verts/edges on as necessary to match the path. then also to be able to do this with painting so i can outline an area i want to fill with paint would help me stay in the lines a lot better
resolution: Added a live editable UV workspace with persistent external raster baselines, a denser shader library, shared pen fills, and generated Pen Plane geometry.
